# Kiro ACP 2.18.1 agent-profile evidence corpus

Secret-free empty-set evidence for g04.090 card 257 / Research 254.

Official ACP docs advertise `kiro-cli acp --agent my-agent`. That placeholder
is not closed portable membership. Built-in and custom agent names live in
interactive/custom-agent docs and ambient `.kiro/agents/` /
`~/.kiro/agents/` state. Official troubleshooting documents fallback to the
default agent without warning. Exact `2.18.1` platform archives returned
HTTP 403 on 2026-08-28. Initialize `agentInfo` is product identity, not an
applied-profile confirmation.

No live ACP initialize. No provider prompt. No install. No host `kiro-cli`
mutation. No profile create/edit/set-default. Do not promote chat `/agent`,
`session/set_mode`, or ambient host profiles onto `kiro.acp`.

No fixture contains a credential, host path, account identity, provider
payload, or real session id.
